newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MOL, TVK set up French trading co.
newsitem.headline: MOL, TVK set up French trading co.

text.p: Hungarian chemicals company TVK Rt and oil company MOL Rt have set up a 50-50 joint trading company in France, TVK said on Wednesday.

"The heads of the two companies have recently signed the agreement on establishing TVK-MOL-Chem Sarl trading company in Paris with a registered capital of 500,000 French francs," TVK said in a statement.
It added that the trading company will sell in France TVK's plastics base material, semi-finished and finished products as well as MOL's petrochemical products.
The statement said the founders expected a 40 million French francs turnover in the first year.
At 0948 GMT, MOL shares stood at 3,410 forints, up 190, and TVk shares at 2,870 forints, up 20.
